ledger: White semi truck (tractor + dark trailer) | parked left of diner at night, steam rising from it | gone by end of video | replaced overnight by a different vehicle
Green Kenworth-style box truck | absent at start | parked directly outside diner window at sunrise | trucker walks to it and opens door
Trucker (gray-haired man, brown jacket) | enters diner at night, sits at counter | exits at sunrise and approaches box truck | served coffee and a plated breakfast, pays with a $100 bill
Waitress (blue polo, white apron, glasses on apron) | wiping counter alone at night | watching trucker through window at sunrise | pours coffee, serves plate twice, accepts cash

findings.description: The vehicle outside the diner completely changes. From 00:00-00:10 it is a white conventional semi tractor pulling a dark trailer, parked a noticeable distance from the building in the gravel lot. At 01:43 the truck outside the window is a dark-green Kenworth-style box truck (single-unit, different cab, color, and configuration) parked immediately adjacent to the window, close enough that the man reaches it in a few steps. No explanation is given for the swap or the change in parking position.

findings.entity: Breakfast plate served to the trucker
findings.description: The man is already shown with the fried-egg-and-bread plate in front of him at the counter from 00:34-00:45 (including a dedicated close-up of the plate). At 01:11-01:18 the waitress places what appears to be the same plated breakfast in front of him again, duplicating the serving of a meal he already has, with no shot of the first plate being cleared or eaten.
